name: Seikoujo Claudia
source: King Belze of Jotun was known as the Overlord. He fought many wars aiming for conquest. One time his attention was attracted by a neighboring country, Bardo. Small yet wealthy place ruled by Princess Claudia. Belze planned to obtain the land, but he also had a special interest in the princess herself.
translation: 约顿国王贝尔泽素有霸王之称。他发动无数战争，意在征服四方。某次，邻国巴尔多吸引了他的注意。那是一个虽小却富裕的国家，由克劳迪娅公主统治。贝尔泽计划夺取那片土地，同时也对公主本人抱有特殊兴趣。
